summary: Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 7, 2026, to report its unaudited financial results for the six months ended March 31, 2026, via a press release and financial statements. The filing is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, covering revenue decline, segment changes, and corporate developments. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or management change is disclosed. The filing does not trigger any special-situations category; it is an ordinary periodic report.
